link.note: Same-name trap: NOT John's ancestor James Smith (1688), and not a Bull Smith.

summary: A different Hauppauge James Smith (d. 1837 aged 95), from Lake Ronkonkoma; not related as far as known.
bio: Came from Lake Ronkonkoma with brother Alexander, bought land from Joseph Blydenburgh, married Catherine Blydenburgh; family legend traced them to men who came from England to build Trinity Church; line ran to Moses R. Smith and Judge Wilmot M. Smith. Zephaniah and Jonathan Smith belonged to 'another family of Smiths'.
